indicator: Ever assessed by a physician as having a disability
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_2018_wave7: w01C003 ~ w07C003 (same respondent linked across waves)
klosa_2024_wave10: w01C003 ~ w10C003 (same respondent linked across waves)
klosa_derivation: Link each respondent's reports from first participation through the index wave. Code 1 for any affirmative report of a physician's disability assessment. Code 0 if there is no prior affirmative report and the current answer is no (5). Treat all other cases as unknown.
charls_comparability_notes: KLoSA captures a history of physician-assessed disability. CHARLS asks whether respondents have each type of disability. Current administrative registration is a separate measure.

indicator: Health limits ability to work
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Codes 1 and 2 indicate that health limits work.
charls_comparability_notes: CHARLS distinguishes inability to work, inability to work long hours and no problem working. KLoSA asks about the degree of interference with work.

indicator: Poor or very poor distance vision
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Count ratings of 4 or 5 and include blindness (C074=3).
charls_comparability_notes: CHARLS code 4 means fair and code 5 means poor. Use 5 as the initial match and assess sensitivity across all response categories. Include blindness (DA032=2).

indicator: Poor or very poor near vision
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Count ratings of 4 or 5 and include blindness (C074=3).
charls_comparability_notes: CHARLS code 4 means fair and code 5 means poor. Use 5 as the initial match and assess sensitivity across all response categories. Include blindness (DA032=2).

indicator: Poor or very poor hearing
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Count ratings of 4 or 5. Respondents who usually wear hearing aids report aided hearing.
charls_comparability_notes: CHARLS code 4 means fair and code 5 means poor. Use 5 as the initial match and assess sensitivity across all response categories.

indicator: Needs assistance with dressing
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: 1 = independent, 3 or 5 = needs assistance.
charls_comparability_notes: Code CHARLS responses 3 and 4 as needing assistance and 1 and 2 as independent. Apply the codebook procedure for valid skips triggered by the preceding mobility items. Treat item nonresponse as missing. Dressing includes getting clothes out and fastening them.

indicator: Needs assistance with bathing or showering
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: 1 = independent, 3 or 5 = needs assistance.
charls_comparability_notes: Code CHARLS responses 3 and 4 as needing assistance and 1 and 2 as independent. Apply the codebook procedure for valid skips triggered by the preceding mobility items. Treat item nonresponse as missing. In KLoSA, an inability to scrub one’s back unaided on its own is excluded.

indicator: Needs assistance with eating a prepared meal
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: 1 = independent, 3 or 5 = needs assistance.
charls_comparability_notes: Code CHARLS responses 3 and 4 as needing assistance and 1 and 2 as independent. Apply the codebook procedure for valid skips triggered by the preceding mobility items. Treat item nonresponse as missing. Unaided eating is classified as independent even when an implement is used.

indicator: Needs assistance with using the toilet
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: 1 = independent, 3 or 5 = needs assistance.
charls_comparability_notes: Code CHARLS responses 3 and 4 as needing assistance and 1 and 2 as independent. Apply the codebook procedure for valid skips triggered by the preceding mobility items. Treat item nonresponse as missing. KLoSA specifies removing clothing and cleaning oneself. CHARLS specifies sitting down and standing up.

domain: Long-term care needs and receipt of care
indicator: Needs assistance with preparing meals
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: 1 = independent, 3 or 5 = needs assistance.
charls_comparability_notes: Code CHARLS responses 3 and 4 as needing assistance and 1 and 2 as independent. Apply the codebook procedure for valid skips triggered by the preceding mobility items. Treat item nonresponse as missing. Includes preparing ingredients, cooking and serving. CHARLS specifies health-related reasons. Consider household role allocation.

domain: Long-term care needs and receipt of care
indicator: Needs assistance with shopping
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: 1 = independent, 3 or 5 = needs assistance.
charls_comparability_notes: Code CHARLS responses 3 and 4 as needing assistance and 1 and 2 as independent. Apply the codebook procedure for valid skips triggered by the preceding mobility items. Treat item nonresponse as missing. KLoSA includes general shopping. CHARLS asks about buying groceries.

domain: Long-term care needs and receipt of care
indicator: Needs assistance with managing money
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: 1 = independent, 3 or 5 = needs assistance.
charls_comparability_notes: Code CHARLS responses 3 and 4 as needing assistance and 1 and 2 as independent. Apply the codebook procedure for valid skips triggered by the preceding mobility items. Treat item nonresponse as missing. Both cover spending and managing assets. KLoSA counts delegating large financial transactions as partial help.

domain: Long-term care needs and receipt of care
indicator: Needs assistance with taking medications
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: 1 = independent, 3 or 5 = needs assistance.
charls_comparability_notes: Code CHARLS responses 3 and 4 as needing assistance and 1 and 2 as independent. Apply the codebook procedure for valid skips triggered by the preceding mobility items. Treat item nonresponse as missing. Covers the timing and dose of medicines. Distinguish no medicine use or inapplicability from nonresponse.

indicator: Needs assistance with at least one of four basic activities of daily living
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Require a valid response (1, 3 or 5) for every item. Count activities requiring partial (3) or full (5) assistance. Threshold: one or more.
charls_comparability_notes: Code CHARLS responses 3 and 4 as needing assistance and 1 and 2 as independent. Apply the codebook procedure for valid skips triggered by the preceding mobility items. Treat item nonresponse as missing.

indicator: Ever diagnosed with hypertension
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Derived variable: 1 = diagnosed, 5 = no reported diagnosis.
charls_comparability_notes: Based on diagnosis history. Measured blood pressure is a separate outcome. Use the CHARLS binary variable incorporating diagnoses from prior waves.

indicator: Ever diagnosed with diabetes or high blood sugar
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Derived variable: 1 = diagnosed, 5 = no reported diagnosis.
charls_comparability_notes: Both surveys include a diagnosis of high blood sugar. Use the CHARLS binary variable incorporating diagnoses from prior waves.

indicator: Ever diagnosed with cancer or a malignant tumour
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Derived variable: 1 = diagnosed, 5 = no reported diagnosis.
charls_comparability_notes: Exclude minor skin cancers. Use the CHARLS binary variable incorporating diagnoses from prior waves.

indicator: Ever diagnosed with chronic lung disease
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Derived variable: 1 = diagnosed, 5 = no reported diagnosis.
charls_comparability_notes: Exclude cancer. Check disease examples and how each survey treats asthma. Use the CHARLS binary variable incorporating diagnoses from prior waves.

indicator: Ever diagnosed with liver disease
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Derived variable: 1 = diagnosed, 5 = no reported diagnosis.
charls_comparability_notes: KLoSA excludes fatty liver. CHARLS excludes fatty liver, tumours and cancer. Use the CHARLS binary variable incorporating diagnoses from prior waves.

indicator: Ever diagnosed with heart disease
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Derived variable: 1 = diagnosed, 5 = no reported diagnosis.
charls_comparability_notes: The examples and types of heart disease covered may differ. Use the CHARLS binary variable incorporating diagnoses from prior waves.

indicator: Ever diagnosed with cerebrovascular disease
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Derived variable: 1 = diagnosed, 5 = no reported diagnosis. Code 3 is a valid response and does not count as a confirmed case.
charls_comparability_notes: KLoSA code 3 denotes suspected stroke or transient ischaemic attack and does not count as a confirmed diagnosis. CHARLS asks about stroke. Use the CHARLS binary variable incorporating diagnoses from prior waves.

indicator: Ever diagnosed with arthritis or rheumatism
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Derived variable: 1 = diagnosed, 5 = no reported diagnosis.
charls_comparability_notes: Based on a self-reported diagnosis history. Use the CHARLS binary variable incorporating diagnoses from prior waves.

indicator: Number of diagnosed conditions
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_2018_wave7: w07chronic_a, w07chronic_b, w07chronic_c, w07chronic_d, w07chronic_e, w07chronic_f, w07chronic_g, w07chronic_i
klosa_2024_wave10: w10chronic_a, w10chronic_b, w10chronic_c, w10chronic_d, w10chronic_e, w10chronic_f, w10chronic_g, w10chronic_i
charls_2018_wave4_items_or_harmonized_va: r4hibpe, r4diabe, r4cancre, r4lunge, r4livere, r4hearte, r4stroke, r4arthre
klosa_derivation: Count diagnoses (0–8) among respondents with valid information on all eight specified conditions.
charls_comparability_notes: Covers eight physical conditions. Access to diagnosis and the scope of each item affect the count. Report condition-specific estimates alongside it.

indicator: Multimorbidity (two or more diagnosed conditions)
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_2018_wave7: w07chronic_a, w07chronic_b, w07chronic_c, w07chronic_d, w07chronic_e, w07chronic_f, w07chronic_g, w07chronic_i
klosa_2024_wave10: w10chronic_a, w10chronic_b, w10chronic_c, w10chronic_d, w10chronic_e, w10chronic_f, w10chronic_g, w10chronic_i
charls_2018_wave4_items_or_harmonized_va: r4hibpe, r4diabe, r4cancre, r4lunge, r4livere, r4hearte, r4stroke, r4arthre
klosa_derivation: At least two diagnoses among respondents with valid information on all eight conditions.
charls_comparability_notes: Covers eight physical conditions. Access to diagnosis and the scope of each item affect the count. Report condition-specific estimates alongside it.

indicator: Three or more diagnosed chronic conditions
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_2018_wave7: w07chronic_a, w07chronic_b, w07chronic_c, w07chronic_d, w07chronic_e, w07chronic_f, w07chronic_g, w07chronic_i
klosa_2024_wave10: w10chronic_a, w10chronic_b, w10chronic_c, w10chronic_d, w10chronic_e, w10chronic_f, w10chronic_g, w10chronic_i
charls_2018_wave4_items_or_harmonized_va: r4hibpe, r4diabe, r4cancre, r4lunge, r4livere, r4hearte, r4stroke, r4arthre
klosa_derivation: At least three diagnoses among respondents with valid information on all eight conditions.
charls_comparability_notes: Covers eight physical conditions. Access to diagnosis and the scope of each item affect the count. Report condition-specific estimates alongside it.

indicator: Ever diagnosed with dementia
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Code 1 in the derived disease-history variable. The meaning of code 3 was cross-checked against diagnostic item Cadd_01.
charls_comparability_notes: The Chinese item covers several conditions, including memory-related conditions and Parkinson's disease. The resulting diagnosis rates have different case definitions.

indicator: Ever diagnosed with mild cognitive impairment
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Code 3 in the derived disease-history variable, cross-checked against diagnostic item Cadd_01.
charls_comparability_notes: The Chinese item covers several conditions, including memory-related conditions and Parkinson's disease. The resulting diagnosis rates have different case definitions.

indicator: K-MMSE-2 total score
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Provider-released total score, range 0–30.
charls_comparability_notes: The test version, language, scoring and survey years differ.

indicator: Orientation to time (four items)
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Sum correct responses for year, month, date and day of the week (0–4).
charls_comparability_notes: The four date components align. Exclude nonadministration and nonresponse in CHARLS.

indicator: Orientation to time including season
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Sum correct responses for year, month, date, day of the week and season (0–5).
charls_comparability_notes: The harmonized CHARLS variable r4orient has a maximum of 4. Add r4ssn for a maximum of 5.

indicator: Serial sevens
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Sum correct responses across the five subtractions (0–5).
charls_comparability_notes: Score each subtraction relative to the immediately preceding response. Check refusals, nonadministration, assistance and scoring instructions.

indicator: Immediate registration of three words
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Count words correctly registered on first presentation (0–3).
charls_comparability_notes: Use the number correct on the first trial of the CHARLS three-word task. The harmonized ten-word measure is a different task. The language and stimulus words differ.

indicator: Delayed recall of three words
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Count words recalled after a delay (0–3).
charls_comparability_notes: Use the CHARLS three-word task. The number of presentations, recall interval and intervening tasks differ.

indicator: K-MMSE-2 total score among respondents who completed the test without assistance
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older who received no assistance during the test
charls_2018_wave4_items_or_harmonized_va: Check available flags for assistance and proxy interviews
klosa_derivation: Total score (0–30) among respondents with C420=1.
charls_comparability_notes: A sensitivity analysis restricting the sample by whether assistance was received during the test.

domain: Long-term care needs and receipt of care
indicator: Needs assistance with at least one of four instrumental activities of daily living
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Require a valid response (1, 3 or 5) for every item. Count activities requiring partial (3) or full (5) assistance. Threshold: one or more.
charls_comparability_notes: Code CHARLS responses 3 and 4 as needing assistance and 1 and 2 as independent. Apply the codebook procedure for valid skips triggered by the preceding mobility items. Treat item nonresponse as missing. Check household roles, the scope of shopping and delegation of money management.

domain: Long-term care needs and receipt of care
indicator: Needs assistance with at least one of the eight common activities
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year

klosa_derivation: Require a valid response (1, 3 or 5) for every item. Count activities requiring partial (3) or full (5) assistance. Threshold: one or more.
comparison_status: Priority for comparison, with conditions for IADLs
charls_comparability_notes: Code CHARLS responses 3 and 4 as needing assistance and 1 and 2 as independent. Apply the codebook procedure for valid skips triggered by the preceding mobility items. Treat item nonresponse as missing. Functional proxy for long-term care need.

domain: Long-term care needs and receipt of care
indicator: Independent in all four basic activities but needs help with at least one instrumental activity
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
charls_2018_wave4_items_or_harmonized_va: r4dressb r4bathb r4eatb r4toiltb / r4mealsb r4shopb r4moneyb r4medsb
klosa_derivation: Needs help with none of the four basic activities and at least one of the four instrumental activities. Require valid responses on all eight.
comparison_status: Priority for comparison, with conditions for IADLs
charls_comparability_notes: Classification within the eight common activities. Consider gender roles and opportunities to perform instrumental activities.

domain: Long-term care needs and receipt of care
indicator: Needs assistance with at least two of the eight common activities
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
charls_2018_wave4_items_or_harmonized_va: r4dressb r4bathb r4eatb r4toiltb / r4mealsb r4shopb r4moneyb r4medsb
klosa_derivation: Require a valid response (1, 3 or 5) for every item. Count activities requiring partial (3) or full (5) assistance. Threshold: two or more.
charls_comparability_notes: Counts activities requiring help. Care hours and formal care-need grades are separate measures.

domain: Long-term care needs and receipt of care
indicator: Needs assistance with at least one of all 17 Korean survey activities
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year
klosa_derivation: Require a valid response (1, 3 or 5) for every item. Count activities requiring partial (3) or full (5) assistance. Threshold: one or more of all 17.
charls_comparability_notes: The number and mix of activities in the full instruments differ between surveys.

domain: Long-term care needs and receipt of care
indicator: Has no caregiver, among respondents needing help with the eight common activities
denominator_definition: Respondents needing assistance with at least one of the eight common activities

klosa_derivation: Check all five caregiver slots. Classify as no caregiver when slot one is 56 and no slot contains a valid caregiver.
charls_comparability_notes: Check the CHARLS 0/1 indicator of help received across all surveyed activities. Preserve special missing codes. The caregiver modules cover different numbers and types of activities.

domain: Long-term care needs and receipt of care
indicator: No history of physician-assessed disability, among respondents needing help with the eight common activities
denominator_definition: Respondents needing assistance with at least one of the eight common activities
klosa_2018_wave7: w07C201, w07C203, w07C204, w07C206, w07C210, w07C214, w07C215, w07C217, w01C003 ~ w07C003 (same respondent linked across waves)
klosa_2024_wave10: w10C201, w10C203, w10C204, w10C206, w10C210, w10C214, w10C215, w10C217, w01C003 ~ w10C003 (same respondent linked across waves)
charls_2018_wave4_items_or_harmonized_va: DA005[1–5] / assess the overlap of self-reported disability and functional limitations separately in CHARLS
klosa_derivation: Among those needing help with at least one common activity, count those with no positive disability assessment at any wave and a current answer of no.
charls_comparability_notes: Physician assessment, administrative disability registration and certification for long-term care are distinct measures.

domain: Long-term care needs and receipt of care
indicator: Currently uses Korean Long-Term Care Insurance services
denominator_definition: Respondents aged 65 or older in the survey year

charls_comparability_notes: Self-reported use of services. Insurance eligibility and the proportion of all care needs met require separate measures.

denominator_definition: Respondents needing assistance with at least one of the eight common activities

klosa_derivation: Use the reported service-use response first. Code non-use when a negative answer on awareness or application caused the service-use item to be skipped.
